Signature encodings, MTU limits, and workspace helpers for disco packet handling.

# Purpose
`fd_disco_base.h` defines shared constants and inline helper functions for the disco layer. It sets packet and message limits such as `FD_NET_MTU`, `FD_TPU_MTU`, `FD_GOSSIP_MTU`, and shred-related sizes, and it defines protocol and packet type values used across network, TPU, gossip, shred, repair, and replay paths. The file also includes static checks for key size limits, such as `FD_SHRED_OUT_MTU` and `FD_MAX_TXN_PER_SLOT`, so other code can use the same bounds without creating circular dependencies.

The main part of the file is a set of signature encode and decode helpers. Functions such as [`fd_disco_netmux_sig`](<#fd_disco_netmux_sig>), [`fd_disco_poh_sig`](<#fd_disco_poh_sig>), [`fd_disco_bank_sig`](<#fd_disco_bank_sig>), [`fd_disco_shred_out_shred_sig`](<#fd_disco_shred_out_shred_sig>), [`fd_disco_shred_out_fec_sig`](<#fd_disco_shred_out_fec_sig>), [`fd_disco_repair_shred_sig`](<#fd_disco_repair_shred_sig>), and [`fd_disco_repair_replay_sig`](<#fd_disco_repair_replay_sig>) pack fields like slot, protocol, bank tile, FEC set index, shred index, and completion flags into `ulong` values. Matching accessor functions extract each field from the packed signatures. The file also includes workspace helper functions, [`fd_disco_compact_chunk0`](<#fd_disco_compact_chunk0>) and [`fd_disco_compact_wmark`](<#fd_disco_compact_wmark>), which compute chunk offsets and watermark values from `fd_wksp_private` state.
